cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Wonderful, we can take a brush for the picnic crumbs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I'm carrying all the sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Perfect. Grab the picnic blanket without climbing stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Built-in refrigeration. Put them beside the wine; this door is catering.

mechanism: A supervises a picnic helper by treating each wrong door destination as a useful supply stop, correcting practical handling to exploit the glitch.
confusable: D161 changes secret mission; D164 preserves the picnic aim while treating failures as system benefits.
comparison: Physical supply gathering differs from administrative gains from a backward clock.
seedUse: Keep cupboard, attic and cellar uses, but address B's full hands when asking for a blanket.
